intro.text: A Regal, once known as Govi, who leads four guards at the gemstone vault of Kholinar Palace.

items.text: Around Palahes 1175 the Fused El came to the palace vault. Heshual deferred to him and let him in, then watched in horror as El took up the gemstone holding the rest of Jezrien's soul and destroyed it with Anti-Stormlight. Heshual panicked and ran for the other guards.

appearance.text: He wears envoyform and seems to understand how Polestones interact with Lights, including Anti-Light.

personality.text: He struggles to find the right rhythm; El finds him timid for such a prestigious post.
